overall: The AG found no violation in the Personnel Committee's executive session to interview School Committee candidates as a preliminary screening committee under Purpose 8, while cautioning about the vote's stated purpose and single-finalist notices.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Personnel Committee improperly convened in executive session to interview candidates for School Committee appointment, arguing a standing subcommittee cannot act as a preliminary screening committee.
allegations.key_passage: We therefore find no violation in the Committee’s entry into executive session to interview candidates to narrow the field for further consideration by the Council.

allegations.summary: The motion to enter executive session stated only 'for the purpose of personnel' rather than the Purpose 8 basis for the interviews; the AG noted concern without making a violation finding.
allegations.key_passage: There is no executive session purpose for general discussion of personnel matters.

allegations.summary: Notice listed selection of a single applicant per category for recommendation; the AG noted concern about preliminary screening requirements but said this was not part of the complaint.
allegations.key_passage: We make no finding as to whether the Committee violated the Open Meeting Law as to this requirement, as this was not an allegation of the complaint.
